confidence_notes: Holistic estimates from general knowledge, not checked against live listings. Restaurant and beer anchors are the most reliable. Cocktail and wine are bounded using local tourist-bar price ratios to beer, since direct knowledge is weaker. Hotel and hostel prices are least certain because July is peak season and rates vary widely. FX: the rate is from a web search summary citing RBA daily F11 figures for 15 October 2026 (0.6955 at 4pm). The returned search results did not show the RBA table contents and I did not open the rba.gov.au table, so verify this rate against the RBA F11.1 series before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: Antalya is a Mediterranean resort city on Turkey's southern coast, transcontinental, so Europe was chosen as the region. Prices are benchmarked against southern European coastal resort cities with similar summer tourism demand, adjusted for Turkey's lower restaurant and accommodation price levels.
